about.text:
W41 · How to Redirect a Domain to Another Domain (With HTTPS That Actually Works) · approved cut, 5:09 (commit 9ca8786).

Every frame is a live HTML mockup at 1920×1080, redrawn from the film. One canvas for the whole channel: each video gets its own page here, named after the video, starting from a copy of the latest video's frames (rules: docs/youtube-style-canvas.md in redirhub/reels).

Code tokens: src/remotion/brand/tokens.ts. Film stills: youtube/01_library/style/keyframes/w41-redirect-domain/.

rowA.text: Act A · Open on the problem

rowB.text: Act B–C · Teach one idea at a time, then do it in the dashboard

rowC.text: Act D · Prove it, then close

w43-AddressBar-note.text:
NEW · beat 17. The twist, made personal.
IN: push-in from the typo card. The address bar fills the frame; the other names stack behind it.
"rna" is the swapped letters, red with a wavy underline.
Then 1 s of silence.
OUT: TIME-REVERSE, the film's only one. Bar → cards → five lines run back to their domains…
ROOM: Twist night (dark red)

w43-AllGreen-note.text:
The one combined-result frame (new).
IN: back to the grid. Rows turn teal one by one, four pops.
OUT: silence (done). Then the honest note.
ROOM: Brand radial

w43-Checker-note.text:
Beats 43–45.
IN: the morph lands in the input. Check Redirect. The chain draws: hop 1 → 301 → hop 2 → 200.
The three checks land on "One hop. A 301. Lands on…"
FIXED CHIME on "That's a pass" (1 of 2). Beat 45 is VO only.
FLAG: the checker's result layout is drawn, not captured (open-questions).
ROOM: Lab: Night + grid, teal glow

w43-ConnectDNS-note.text:
Beats 33–38.
IN: Hostnames → Connect DNS. The real dialog (Automatic tab) over the new app shell, dimmed, Hostnames active. Rows highlight as she names A, TXT, CNAME www.
The MX tip slides in on 38 (register change).
VO NEEDS "copy yours, not mine": the real edge IP is on screen.
OUT: cut to the checks.
ROOM: Light (product room)

w43-Copies-note.text:
THE TWIST · beats 15–16.
IN: the room plunges from light to dark red. The cards stay put, drain to grey and get stamped COPY one by one; mybrand.net stays lit under the magnifier (the frame's only amber): Google's pick, labelled Example.
SOUND: one soft problem tone as the room drops.
OUT: push into the address bar of the typo card.
FEEL: the floor shifts.
ROOM: Twist night (dark red)

w43-DeadEnds-note.text:
Beats 6–7.
IN: cut. Parked page, then "can't be reached", then "Not secure" racks into focus (focus rack: three places, one job).
OUT: cut to the title.
SOUND: one soft problem tone on "Not secure". FEEL: a small, specific loss, never blame.
ROOM: Dark mesh, red glow under the stage

w43-DomainRedirect-note.text:
Beats 25–29. UI: Unified Links prototype, "New domain redirect" (03-create-redirect).
IN: Links → Create → Domain Redirect, three quick cuts on her three words (the prototype's create chooser).
Fields fill on her words: mybrand.net → https://mybrand.com; "301 · Permanent" on "Type"; "Keep the path" on "path"; What happens fills with three hops. On 29 the form's own hint "A root domain also covers www." takes a teal ring.
OUT: Create redirect → success sound → the list.
FLAG: release timing and the "Passes SEO value" hint (open-questions UI-10, UI-11).
ROOM: Light (product room)

w43-Domains-note.text:
Beats 1–5 · cold open, no eyebrow.
IN: cut on her first word. Each pill appears on its name: .com, .net, .co, then the typo (the swapped letters underlined), then the flyer one.
OUT: dock. The pills slide left as the dead ends open (now they're context).
SOUND: pad only. FEEL: "that's me".
ROOM: Dark mesh (site hero) + grid

w43-EndCard-note.text:
Beats 50–52.
IN: the five hook pills turn teal and collapse into "Five domains. One website." FIXED CHIME (2 of 2).
The right half stays clear for YouTube's end screen (next week's video).
The QR slot waits for the branded link.
ROOM: Dark mesh (site hero)

w43-FourAddresses-note.text:
Beats 40–43.
IN: one domain splits into four (2 × 2), then the grid fills row by row to sixteen (draw).
On "easiest to forget" the https://www. column takes the amber outline.
OUT: shared-element morph. The amber cell https://www.mybrand.net flies into the checker's input.
ROOM: Lab: Night + grid

w43-Honest-note.text:
Beat 47.
Register change: the film steps back and talks straight. No effect.
The teal card (what it does) lands first and holds; then the grey card (what it doesn't).
OUT: cut. FEEL: trust.
ROOM: Charcoal

w43-HttpsIssued-note.text:
Beat 39.
IN: the three steps tick down the list. On "automatically" the padlock closes and grows out of the dialog (shared element).
SOUND: success. FEEL: step three pays off.
ROOM: Brand sweep (payoff)

w43-LinksList-note.text:
Beats 30–32. UI: Unified Links prototype, new app shell + Links list.
IN: cut on Create redirect. Cards arrive one by one, every one ↳ https://mybrand.com (a pop each).
The CSV tip slides in on "dozens" (register change).
AMBER: the orange split Create button, the frame's only amber.
OUT: cut to Hostnames.
ROOM: Light (product room)

w43-MainAddress-note.text:
Beats 22–24.
IN: shared-element morph. The main pill from way two grows; the other four dim. The two chips land on "exactly".
The tip slides in beside (register change: an aside).
OUT: cut into the dashboard. FEEL: a decision, made calmly.
ROOM: Light (product room)

w43-OneAddress-note.text:
Beats 18–20.
IN: …and re-route: four domains fan into one node, then a thick teal line to https://mybrand.com. A 301 tag pops onto each line on "with a 301".
OUT: the main card docks as the steps come up.
SOUND: one pop per tag. FEEL: relief.
ROOM: Dark mesh, teal glow on the main address

w43-Perfect-note.text:
NEW · beats 12–14. Way one, the calm before the twist.
IN: five lines draw into one host; five identical sites pop up, each with its own address, and each takes a teal tick.
BEAT: hold alone on "And it looks perfect." Leave the beat.
OUT: the room drops to dark red with the cards in place (same layout as the next frame, so it reads as a reversal).
ROOM: Light + dot pattern

w43-Pointer-note.text:
Beats 10–11.
IN: room change, dark → light (act B opens). The mybrand.com pill from the hook morphs into this glass pill; the dotted line draws to the address book, then to the site.
OUT: the one pill becomes five as the five sites rise into the next frame.
FEEL: oh, a domain is just a pointer.
ROOM: Light + dot pattern

w43-Renew-note.text:
Beat 48.
IN: cut. The flyer domain and its paper renewal calendar (the date is an example).
OUT: the step map returns ticked for the recap (49), then the end card.
ROOM: Light + paper prop

w43-Steps-note.text:
Beat 21, reused ticked at the recap (49).
A list replaces narration: VO says only "Three steps, and one test."
At 49 each card takes a teal check as she names it.
OUT: transition sound, 2 of 2. Card 01 morphs into step one (room change into the light product room).
ROOM: Brand radial + floor

w43-Title-note.text:
Beats 8–9, merged into one line (script-deltas #2).
IN: transition sound, 1 of 2. The five grey dots draw into one teal dot, then the title lands.
HOLD ≈ 1.5 s. OUT: cut.
FEEL: a promise, not a pitch.
ROOM: Brand sweep + perspective floor

w43about.text:
How to Forward Multiple Domains to One Website (With HTTPS) · W43 · publishes Oct 19.

Key frames for Review 2, round 2 (after Leo's notes, Oct 14): each act now has its own room built from the RedirHub website's gradients (dark mesh, brand sweep, light, twist night, brand radial, lab, charcoal), with the site's glass cards. The twist is three frames: It looks perfect → five copies → the address bar. The dashboard frames use the latest Unified Links prototype (app shell, Links list, New domain redirect).

Comment on any frame. The sticky under it gives the move in and out, the sound, the feeling and the room.

Files: youtube/02_videos/2026-W43_forward-multiple-domains/style-canvas/project/ in redirhub/reels (branch yt/w43-keyframes). Script changes: script-deltas.md; open questions: open-questions.md.
